seoTitle: Workout Interval Timer (HIIT and Tabata with Beeps)
metaDescription: Set work and rest seconds, rounds and sets for HIIT or Tabata. The timer beeps at each change and the last three seconds, and shows the round on screen.
intro: HIIT and Tabata intervals with audio beeps.
why:
Set the get-ready time, work and rest seconds, rounds per set, number of sets and rest between sets. Press Start for a countdown that beeps when a phase changes and for the last three seconds. A Tabata preset sets 20 seconds of work, 10 of rest and 8 rounds.

Sound needs a click on Start first, and you can mute it. The screen shows the round and set. Colours change slowly and nothing flashes. The status line updates once per phase so a screen reader is not flooded.
howTo: Set work, rest, rounds and sets, or press the Tabata preset.
Follow the beeps and the colour.
Pause or Reset at any time.

faq.q: Will the beeps work with the screen off?
faq.a: Browsers may pause timers on a locked or hidden tab. Keep the page in view during a workout.

faq.q: Can I turn the sound off?
faq.a: Yes. Tick Mute beeps. The screen still shows each phase.
No. The work happens in your browser and the page makes no network request with your input.
